symptom: ako/mxcli#2035 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1778): `create or modify microflow` was refused with 'replace case $Source: cannot replace the ExclusiveSplit … it has 9 paths, not two' (or 'drop case …') when anything differed inside a branch of a multi-branch case, including a one-activity change, and also when that case sat in one changed run with activities replaced before it.
cause: diffFlowBody had shell matches for if (sameIfShell, branches spliced) and loops (sameLoopShell / loopPair), but none for an enumeration case: a case that differed anywhere inside was replaced as a whole — or, in a run with other changes, replaced-first-and-dropped — and the splice only takes out a two-path decision.
insight: Each compound statement needs both halves: a shell match for a lone pair (diff its bodies) and a pair finder that splits a run around it, or a change next to it drags it into a replace. Pair branches by position, as describe prints them; a reordered branch is a real split change. Reproduced on TestApp (unfixed binary refuses, fixed splices '1 edited in place', re-run Unchanged, mx check 0 errors). The reporter's other observation — check passing what exec refuses because check reads the catalog's source text (mendixlabs/mxcli#1779) — is a separate cause.
